id_basis: The H-E-B tag reads 'Monstera Thai Constellation, Monstera deliciosa', and the leaves match: heart-shaped juvenile Monstera leaves speckled and splashed with cream, on a moss pole in sphagnum. 'Thai Constellation' is the tissue-cultured variegated form of Monstera deliciosa with stable cream speckling.

Grown from a cutting of the mother plant at a coffee shop in Baraboo, Wisconsin (Ethan: cut about July 31, 2026). It has no tag of its own: the H-E-B tag in the pot belongs to P-095, which was bought in Round Rock. The leaves match 'Thai Constellation': heart-shaped juvenile Monstera leaves speckled and splashed with cream, on a moss pole in sphagnum. 'Thai Constellation' is the tissue-cultured variegated form of Monstera deliciosa with stable cream speckling.
